items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution (CVE-2026-103849), privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these specific issues.

items.title: Template engine injection leading to unauthenticated arbitrary code execution (BlockStrap)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allowing an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to a template engine injection flaw, also referred to as 'BlockStrap' by Sansec. This was addressed in APSB26-153.

items.title: Incorrect authorization flaw in B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.8) in Adobe Commerce B2B that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute code due to an incorrect authorization flaw. This was addressed in APSB26-153.

items.title: Out-of-band fix for StyleSmuggler zero-day
items.summary: An emergency hotfix released for CVE-2026-75650, a critical zero-day unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability that was actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 10.0) zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution through template engine injection, actively exploited in the wild. It affects versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce (regular September bulletin)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws.

items.title: Stored cross-site scripting flaw
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that is exploitable without authentication. This was addressed as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Stored cross-site scripting flaw
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that is exploitable without authentication. This was addressed as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.1) incorrect authorization flaw allowing an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges. It was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 24, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation. It includes CVE-2026-71362.

items.title: Unauthenticated unrestricted file upload
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.6) unauthenticated unrestricted file upload vulnerability, likely addressed as part of the August 2026 security updates.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution. This was addressed as part of APSB26-92.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability. This was addressed as part of APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability. This was addressed as part of APSB26-92.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability. This was addressed as part of APSB26-92.
